SELECT
    count() AS promotion_count,
    round(avg(discount_percent), 2) AS avg_discount_percent,
    round(avg(total_units), 2) AS avg_units_per_promotion,
    round(corrStable(discount_percent, total_units), 4) AS corr_discount_vs_total_units,
    round(corrStable(discount_percent, avg_units_per_order), 4) AS corr_discount_vs_avg_units_per_order,
    if(
        corrStable(discount_percent, total_units) >= 0.2 OR corrStable(discount_percent, avg_units_per_order) >= 0.2,
        'Yes',
        if(
            corrStable(discount_percent, total_units) <= -0.2 AND corrStable(discount_percent, avg_units_per_order) <= -0.2,
            'No',
            'Weak/Mixed'
        )
    ) AS evidence_of_price_elasticity
FROM
(
    SELECT
        p.PromotionKey,
        any(p.PromotionName) AS promotion_name,
        any(p.DiscountPercent) AS discount_percent,
        sum(s.sales_qty) AS total_units,
        countDistinct(s.order_id) AS order_count,
        sum(s.sales_qty) / nullIf(countDistinct(s.order_id), 0) AS avg_units_per_order
    FROM retail.DimPromotion AS p
    INNER JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            PromotionKey,
            SalesQuantity AS sales_qty,
            concat('store-', toString(SalesKey)) AS order_id
        FROM retail.FactSales
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            PromotionKey,
            SalesQuantity AS sales_qty,
            concat('online-', SalesOrderNumber, '-', toString(SalesOrderLineNumber)) AS order_id
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    ) AS s
        ON s.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
    WHERE p.DiscountPercent IS NOT NULL
      AND p.DiscountPercent > 0
    GROUP BY p.PromotionKey
) AS promo;
